subject: Annual prepay invoicing windows and live drawdown ticker handoff
messages:
From: Sarah Lloyd <sarah.lloyd@altair.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>
Cc: procurement@acme-corp.com
Date: 2027-04-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Inquiry: annual prepay schedule + visibility into drawdowns

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the quick demo last week. We're moving toward an annual prepay commitment ($450k) and need to lock down how invoices will be issued and how our engineering/finance teams can track drawdowns in near-real time. A few specifics from our side: 

- We need monthly invoice windows that align with our internal PO (PO #4521).
- Our legal entity in the EU requires VAT reverse-charge wording if invoices are routed there — confirm you can issue invoices to "Redwood Inference EU B.V." with VAT IDs.
- Can you provide a live/extractable drawdown file (CSV or webhook) so our finance system can reconcile each consumption event?
- What are your settlement currency and wire instructions? Net 30 is preferred by procurement.

Can you put together an explicit invoice cadence and a small sample drawdown file so our AP team can validate? Also loop in anyone on your side who owns VAT routing and invoice numbering.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Lloyd
Head of Platform, Altair AI
attachments: PO_4521_Scan.pdf (PDF)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>
To: Sarah Lloyd <sarah.lloyd@altair.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-04-25T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Inquiry: annual prepay schedule + visibility into drawdowns

Hi Sarah — thanks, and great to hear you want to move forward. I've sketched a proposal below and attached a working schedule (Annual_prepay_schedule_v3.xlsx) and an initial drawdown schema. High-level: 

1) Invoicing cadence (proposed):
   - Initial invoice (50% of commitment) issued on contract activation date -> due Net 30.
   - Subsequent monthly invoices (10 equal monthly drawdowns) issued on the 1st of each month to reflect authorized withdrawals against the prepay fund.
   - Final reconciliation invoice after 12 months for any over/under usage.

2) Drawdown visibility:
   - We'll publish a CSV nightly snapshot to a secure S3 link and provide a webhook for real-time events if you want push. See attached sample columns.

3) VAT / entity routing: 
   - Kimberly, can you confirm the exact invoice-to entity name and VAT phrasing for Altair's EU flow?

4) Payment rails & PO:
   - We accept wire and ACH for US; we can map invoices to PO #4521 on the invoice line. I'll confirm bank details once we lock the routing.

Next steps: Kimberly to confirm VAT language & entity; Priyom to produce the first live drawdown CSV and confirm invoice numbering; Laura to own the final billing contact and DocuSign link. Once we align, I'll send the consolidated schedule + DocuSign for sign-off.

Vivek
VP, Customer Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
attachments: Annual_prepay_schedule_v3.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference>

Hi all,

Quick VAT confirmation from our tax team for EU routing:

- Invoice-to entity: Redwood Inference EU B.V.
- EU VAT ID: NL123456789B01
- Required invoice phrasing for reverse charge: "VAT reverse-charged under Article 194, place of supply: customer member state."

If Altair provides their EU VAT ID on the PO, we can issue zero-rated invoices with reverse-charge wording. Otherwise invoices should be issued net of VAT and Altair will self-account.

Operational notes:
- Please ensure the invoice includes the PO number on the invoice header (PO #4521) and the customer billing contact (as provided by Sarah).
- We recommend a small 1.5% holdback on monthly drawdowns to cover any VAT/tax reconciliation differences — released on final reconciliation invoice. If that's a hard no, we can remove it.

Attaching: VAT_certificate_Redwood_EU.pdf (PDF) for their records.

Kimberly
Head of Tax & Compliance
Redwood Inference
